---
title: "squirrels"
---

(Setup)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(cowsay)
set.seed(42)
```

Squirrel steals seeds
```{r}
results <- c("SUCCESS", "FAIL")
probs <- c(0.3, 0.7)

trials <- sample(x = results, size = 150, replace = TRUE, prob = probs)

num_success <-  sum(trials == "SUCCESS") 

say(paste("I was successful", num_success, "times!"), by="squirrel")
```

1000 squirrels steal seeds
```{r}
combined_successes <- c()
for (i in seq_len(1000)) {
  is_success <- sample(c("SUCCESS", "FAILURE"),
    size = 150,
    replace = TRUE,
    prob = c(0.3, 0.7)
  )
  n_successes <- sum(is_success == "SUCCESS")
  combined_successes <- c(combined_successes, n_successes)
}

df_squirrels <- tibble("N_Successful_Heists" = combined_successes)
gt(head(df_squirrels))

ggplot(
  df_squirrels,
  aes(
    x = N_Successful_Heists
  )
) + 
  geom_bar() +
  ggtitle("Number of Successful Heists per Squirrel - Simulated") +
  xlab("Number of successful heists") +
  ylab("Number of squirrels") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Theretical binomial distribution
```{r}
df_squirrels_probs <- tibble()

for (i in seq_len(150)) {
  prob_success <- dbinom(i, 150, 0.3)
  current_row <- tibble(
    successes = i, 
    probs_success = prob_success)
  
  df_squirrels_probs <- tibble(df_squirrels_probs |> bind_rows(current_row))
}

gt(head(df_squirrels_probs))

ggplot(
  df_squirrels_probs,
  aes(
    x = successes,
    y = probs_success
  )
) + 
  geom_col() +
  ggtitle("Number of Successful Heists per Squirrel - Theoretical") +
  xlab("Number of successful heists") +
  ylab("Number of squirrels") +
  theme_minimal()
```
